title: Zetsu Repository Readiness and Worktree Lifecycle Hotfix

implementation.sandbox: AgentSandboxManager exact-commit worktree binding, bounded reconciliation and owner-scoped session inspection

security_negative_results: registered repositories without an owner grant remain repository_not_authorized
registered repository device/inode identity changes remain rejected
dirty caller content is never copied or auto-committed

cross-user session inspection/reconciliation remains rejected or owner-scoped
grant synchronization is performed only for the authorized canonical repository and clean committed HEAD
normal automatic cleanup uses the existing safe worktree lifecycle and never force-removes a dirty worktree

limitations: A dirty canonical checkout intentionally retains the prior committed grant; checkpoint/normal commit followed by a new delegation is required to materialize newer content.
The live v2 repository status was not ready while the candidate/certification artifact was uncommitted; no dirty files are imported into isolated worktrees.
No model-serving behavior was changed or recertified.
